callerAudit.finding: The only runtime reader selected the retired external tmux branch. All declarations, transport fields and internal callers in that branch are removed; only regression inputs retain the names.

The completion marker had two readers and no concrete writer. The UID helper had only the two marker-selection callers. Endpoint selection now uses TMUX_TMPDIR directly; the existing health response shape is retained without obsolete migration errors.
Its only added behavior was the external supervisor mount. Both callers now consume the unchanged Compose volumes directly; ordinary bind validation and create_host_path behavior remain covered.
No package command, executable, workflow or script invoked it. It implemented preflight only, and had no cutover command. The smoke test and obsolete documentation reference were removed with it.

runLegacyCutover had no production caller or concrete action adapter. The remaining exports belonged solely to the uncalled preflight script and their dedicated tests. The entire isolated module and its five tests were removed.

viewerGateWrapper.failure: The portable owned-runner child guardian treated an exited zombie as alive and failed cleanup. No systemd user manager or writable cgroup is available.

viewerDirect.failure: The script automatically enters the owned runner. Its portable child guardian again rejected already-exited zombie children during cleanup.
